categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Lopal Tech. Co., Ltd. operates three main business segments: (1) LFP cathode materials for lithium-ion batteries, (2) automotive specialty chemicals (including lubricants, diesel exhaust fluids, coolants, and car maintenance products), and (3) lithium carbonate processing services, which emerged as a new business in 2024. The company also has a growing presence in hydrogen energy and related advanced materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced materials science and manufacturing, including proprietary LFP (lithium iron phosphate) and LMFP (lithium manganese iron phosphate) cathode material technologies, single-sintering process for high-voltage LFP, and specialized formulations for automotive chemicals. R&D centers in Shenzhen, Nanjing, and Changzhou drive innovation, with over 400 patents. The company also utilizes vertical integration, in-house lithium carbonate processing, and advanced ERP and warehouse management systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major battery manufacturers (such as CATL Group and LG Energy Solution), automotive OEMs, and industrial clients. The company serves the new energy vehicle (NEV) sector, energy storage system providers, and the broader automotive aftermarket in China and internationally. Two customers accounted for over 10% of revenue each, both in the LFP cathode materials segment.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are primarily based in the PRC, with significant production facilities across China. It is expanding internationally, with production and supply agreements in Japan, South Korea, the United States, and Indonesia. Subsidiaries and joint ventures are established in Singapore, Indonesia, and Hong Kong to support global expansion.
categories.supply_chain_position: Lopal operates midstream and downstream in the supply chain. It manufactures cathode materials for battery producers (midstream), processes lithium carbonate (upstream integration), and supplies specialty chemicals and maintenance products directly to automotive and industrial end-users (downstream). The company is vertically integrating to secure raw materials and stabilize costs.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include global market expansion, production capacity optimization, cost reduction, and supply chain resilience. R&D focuses on next-generation LFP/LMFP cathode materials, sodium-ion and solid-state battery technologies, green and high-performance automotive chemicals, and hydrogen energy solutions. The company emphasizes sustainability, green development, and technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated from product sales: LFP cathode materials, automotive specialty chemicals, and processing services for lithium carbonate. Revenue is recognized at the point of sale. The company also earns from by-products, equipment sales, and emerging hydrogen energy products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Lopal is positioned as a leading global LFP cathode material manufacturer and a top automotive specialty chemical brand in China. Major competitors include other global cathode material suppliers and domestic automotive chemical producers. The company differentiates itself through technological innovation, vertical integration, and strong partnerships with industry leaders like CATL and LG.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of RMB 7.67 billion, down 12.1% year-on-year, with a net loss of RMB 796.4 million (significantly narrowed from 2023). Total assets stood at RMB 15.8 billion. The company has experienced rapid sales volume growth in LFP cathode materials but faces margin pressure from raw material price volatility. It is investing in overseas expansion and production capacity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Lopal emphasizes advanced, high-quality, and environmentally friendly products, leveraging proprietary technologies and a strong R&D pipeline. Its LFP cathode materials offer superior cycle life, safety, and temperature tolerance, while its automotive chemicals are tailored for NEVs and sustainability. The company’s vertical integration, global partnerships, and innovation-driven approach underpin its competitive differentiation.
